scope: Fixed four-milestone first-occurrence predicate fragment; not an arbitrary declarative language
comparison: Each variant against baseline only; retain label-changing and unsatisfiable-profile variants; group globally equivalent complete truth vectors and report multiplicity
certificate_loss: A mask sufficient under baseline but not sufficient under new catalog at an anchor whose evaluated verdict is preserved; not a minimal-family set difference
cohorts: existing purchase-document hash split seed17 test 50931 cases
witness_order: number of distinct milestones, number of clock levels, first-occurrence permutation, clock ranks, profile index, mask; minimal only under this explicit quotient order
limitations: All catalog-profile and timestamp-weak-order completions are admissible
Finite state counts are coverage counts, not empirical probabilities
Single edits are authored controls, not sampled business policies
Minimum certificate cost is a per-completion clairvoyant lower bound, not a globally optimal adaptive policy
